description:
Bring the comments and Rustdoc in gf2-coding tests, benches and examples to the workspace comment contract: current state only, non-obvious content only, shortest form.

## Background

Scope: `crates/gf2-coding/tests/`, `crates/gf2-coding/benches/` and `crates/gf2-coding/examples/`, about 4,400 comment lines on 2026-10-01. Generated data tables keep their provenance headers. Comments citing an external standard, paper or committed receipt are evidence pointers and stay in shortened form.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each comment and Rustdoc block in scope meets the root `AGENTS.md` comment rule: nothing restates adjacent code, and each module-level doc is at most one short orientation paragraph plus the contract statements its public API needs.
- [hard] REQ-02: No comment in scope narrates history or process, or states planned, deferred, excluded or out-of-scope work; a current limitation is restated in present tense, and each removed planned-work statement is matched to or filed as a tracked issue named in the commit message.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each line in scope matching the sweep pattern below is removed or listed with a one-line justification in the commit message.

  ```text
  non-goal|out of scope|not in scope|future work|deferred to|follow-on|phase [a-e]\b|wave [a-z0-9]|(task|issue|story) `?[0-9a-f]{8}|previously|no longer|legacy|migrat
  ```

- [hard] REQ-04: Public API Rustdoc still states purpose, panics, safety conditions and non-obvious complexity; Rustdoc builds without new warnings and the Rust CI gate passes.
- [hard] REQ-05: The diff contains only comment, Rustdoc and whitespace edits, verified by an ignore-whitespace review of every hunk.


## Decisions

- DEC-01: The owner approved on 2026-10-04 a third rework and ruled for `pub` items in `tests/`, `benches/` and `examples/` of gf2-coding: a Rustdoc line that can only paraphrase the item's body is deleted, and the item then carries no Rustdoc. These targets set no `missing_docs` lint, and their `pub` items are test support, outside the public API that REQ-04 names.

- DEC-02: The owner ruled on 2026-10-04 that the nested `if` in `crates/gf2-coding/tests/ldpc_validation.rs`, which `clippy::collapsible_if` flags once the comment between its two conditions is deleted, is collapsed under this issue. The collapsed condition preserves behavior and is the one code hunk outside REQ-05; decision DEC-01 of story ffc35b8c admits lint-forced hunks of this kind.
title: Tersify comments in gf2-coding tests, benches and examples
